name: medusa-store
comment:overrides: A blanket `ajv: ^8.0.0` override used to live here. It forced ajv 8 onto packages that require ajv 6 — eslint, @eslint/eslintrc, and schema-utils/ajv-keywords under babel-loader — which broke ESLint entirely ('Cannot set properties of undefined (setting defaultMeta)'), so `npm run lint` was a silent no-op. Scoped overrides don't help: npm's top-level rule wins over nested ones. Removed so npm resolves each consumer correctly (patched 6.12.6 for the ESLint chain, 8.x for ajv-formats/ajv-draft-04, which declare it themselves).
